title: Headless Blender emits irrelevant PipeWire/OpenAL connection errors
workflow: headless Blender build and GLB import
symptom: Successful headless 3D jobs emitted '[ALSOFT] Failed to connect PipeWire event context', adding misleading error-looking noise to stderr.
expected_behavior: A render/import job that does not consume audio should not attempt a real audio backend.
actual_behavior: Default OpenAL probing attempted PipeWire even though no audio was used.
proposed_fix: Set mature OpenAL Soft environment switch ALSOFT_DRIVERS=null for Blender jobs that do not require audio.
fix_attempt: Repeated build and GLB import with step-local ALSOFT_DRIVERS=null.
verification: PipeWire/OpenAL connection error disappeared while Blender render/export/import behavior remained successful.
